admission.justification: Realized across root pyproject.toml and the two pinpoint ValidationError tests, proved by those test cases, and prevents masking real type errors behind blanket error disables or untyped suppressions.

applicability: All tracked Python files across product, tests, test support, scripts, and .dagger checked by Pyrefly.
conditions: Pyrefly runs with root [tool.pyrefly] where unbound-name stays enabled and bad-argument-type is not disabled.
Per-path missing-argument disables apply only to the four model_construct partial-fixture test files.
exclusions: Two intentional pytest.raises ValidationError extra-field test calls carrying pinpoint # pyrefly: ignore[unexpected-keyword] comments.
statement: The whole tracked Python tree (2,654 files) checks at zero Pyrefly errors with zero bad-argument-type suppressions, unbound-name enabled across all files, per-path missing-argument sub-configs restricted to four model_construct partial-fixture test files, and two pinpoint inline unexpected-keyword ignores on intentional pytest.raises ValidationError calls.
title: Tracked Python checks at zero Pyrefly errors with bounded suppressions
